options.text: A single morsel of food is not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.
A single morsel of food was not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.

questions.solution:

• The given sentence is negative and in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + did not + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + not + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin did not show them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were not shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject **"he"** is performing the action of not eating.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object (a single morsel of food) the subject and use a form of **"to be"** followed by the past participle of the verb (was not eaten).
 
• The preposition **"at"** remains in the same position.
 
• The agent (the person or thing that performs the action) is not necessary in passive voice, but if we want to include it, we can use the preposition "by" followed by the agent.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She killed the cockroach.

options.text: The cockroach was being killed by her.
The cockroach is killed by her.
The cockroach was killed by her.
The cockroach has been killed by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**The cockroach was killed by her.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice in English is formed by using the auxiliary verb "**to be" + past participle of the main verb**.
 
• **Active voice structure**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 
• **Passive voice structure**: __Object of the Active + "to be" verb + Past Participle of the Main Verb + by + Subject of the Active Voice__
 
• In this sentence, "**killed**" is the past participle of the main verb "**to kill**".
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**she**", becomes the agent of the action in the passive voice sentence.
 
• Therefore, "**the cockroach**" becomes the subject of the sentence in the passive voice and is preceded by the auxiliary verb "**was**".

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.
